description: Return the full markdown content of a GrowthBook skill by path. Pass a top-level name from growthbook_list_skills (e.g. feature-flags), or a qualified child path named by a skill (e.g. feature-flags/references/flag-create). Follow the skill's workflow; when it shows `gb-call <METHOD> <PATH> [body]`, use growthbook_api_read for GET and growthbook_api_write for POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE.
